Practised plant-eaters, meat-eaters, and animals that eat both.
Built and read food chains using arrows.

end.parentNote: Asha practised identifying what common animals eat and building food chains. Manav correctly read several chains and explained the arrow direction using the example of a caterpillar eating a mango leaf. They were unsure about some animal-eating questions and what comes after a tiger; no later correction was recorded. At home, ask Manav to make two short chains and say what each animal eats.
